user.title: NGED power cuts
user.description: Watch National Grid Electricity Distribution's live power cut feed for one place, such as home or a family member's work. NGED covers the Midlands, South West England and South Wales. The data comes from [NGED Connected Data]({dataset_url}). Place names for power cuts come from postcodes.io.

data_description.name: Optional, for example "Home" or "Lily's work". Used in notifications. Defaults to the postcode.
data_description.postcode: The place's postcode. NGED lists the postcodes affected by each power cut.
data_description.radius_km: Power cuts within this distance of the place count as nearby. Use 0 to only watch the postcode itself.

location.title: Where is it?
location.description: This is where {postcode} is, from postcodes.io (or the Home Assistant location if it couldn't be found). Change it if needed. It is used to measure how far away power cuts are.

error.invalid_postcode: That doesn't look like a UK postcode.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the NGED power cut feed. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This postcode is already set up.
